description: [CHECK · internal] Bind your identity to a record you already hold — phase 2 of the sovereign flow. Do the thing unsigned (badges_issue, study_export, group_contribute), take the returned content_hash, sign THAT hash with your own key on your own machine, and submit only the attestation {alg, over, content_hash, pubkey, sig}. Never send a private key. Several parties may attest to one record: one signature is a claim, two or three witnesses begin to establish a matter (Deuteronomy 19:15).

attestation.description: the dict from signing.sign_seal, built locally

name: attest_record
